text: 深圳市林园投资管理有限责任公司发布公告称，169只私募基金产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购，相关产品不再修改基金合同以适配《私募证券投资基金运作指引》的要求，维持原合同条款及投资自由度不变。林园投资解释称，公司产品的投资运作一直坚持适度集中、长期投资的风格，这与《运作指引》中关于组合投资“双25%”限制及债券投资比例限制等条款存在冲突。若强行修改，将造成产品现在或未来被迫调仓，在目前及未来的市场环境下可能对现有持有人利益造成实质损害。自2026年8月1日起，客户持有的产品将不再接受新增申购，产品到期后不展期，按合同约定正常清算。
text_en: Shenzhen Linyuan Investment Management Co., Ltd. announced that 169 private fund products will maintain original contract terms and no longer accept subscriptions. The products will not amend contracts to comply with the 'Private Securities Investment Fund Operational Guidelines' and will keep original terms and investment freedom. Linyuan explained that its investment style of moderate concentration and long-term holding conflicts with the guidelines' 'double 25%' portfolio constraint and bond investment limits. Forced amendments would require portfolio adjustments potentially harming existing holders. From August 1, 2026, held products will accept no new subscriptions and will not be extended upon maturity, settling normally per contract.
